decisions.reason: It is very close to the firm's core vessel-management knowledge and strategic push into offshore and renewable markets, so management is likely to see strong absorptive capacity and room to refine rather than exit.

Crew and corporate travel management extends capabilities the firm already has in crew, travel and administration, making it an easy-to-absorb adjacent service that fits customer needs despite some market uncertainty.

An online vessel information portal is a plausible digital extension of existing operational know-how and client relationships, so a growing large firm would likely keep it while learning how to improve its commercial use.

The mobile vessel performance app is the most capability-demanding product here because it needs sustained digital and analytics development, but it still builds on vessel operations knowledge and supports the firm's sustainability direction, so retention is still more likely than withdrawal.
